scripts.check: npm run audit:repo && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test:all
scripts.dev:server: npm run build -w @las/core && npm run build -w @las/storage && npm run dev -w @las/server
scripts.build: tsc -b packages/core packages/storage apps/server && npm run build -w @las/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @las/core && npm run build -w @las/storage && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w @las/server
scripts.startup:install: npm run build && powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/windows/install-startup.ps1
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:browser
